class.name: AudioImporterFmod
class.brief_description: Editor import plugin for importing audio files as FMOD audio streams.
class.description: AudioImporterFmod is an editor plugin that handles importing audio files into [FmodAudioStream] resources. It integrates with Godot's import system to provide seamless audio asset management. Supported formats include common audio types like MP3, WAV, OGG, FLAC, and others supported by FMOD. The importer processes audio files during project import, creating optimized [FmodAudioStream] resources that can be used with [FmodAudioStreamPlayer] and [FmodAudioStreamPlayer3D].
